"query":  "const chunks = [];
for await (const entity of client
  .select({ key: true, attributes: true, payload: true })
  .where(
    eq('manifest', key('0x3d66f28a7b3189aa365bb229cd3ed1b17c0965d2e8e4286a4360e18f81ec9c5b')),
    eq('type', str('arkiv-chunking/chunk/v1')),
  )
  .ownedBy('0xa618A2736431f24C26F1C8Dac9CA00ECc845a1C6')
  .createdBy('0xa618A2736431f24C26F1C8Dac9CA00ECc845a1C6')
  .atBlock(200915n)
  .limit(200)
) chunks.push(entity);"
